seoTitle: How to Add Multiple Pictures to One Instagram Story
metaDescription: Create a photo collage on one Instagram story using the built-in Photo sticker, no third-party apps needed.
intro: Combining several photos into a single Instagram story is a great way to create a collage-style post or tell a fuller story in one slide. This guide shows how to layer multiple pictures using Instagram's built-in Photo sticker feature.

steps.heading: Start a new story
steps.body: Open Instagram, tap the plus icon, and select Story from the options.

steps.heading: Add your first photo
steps.body: Take a new photo or tap the gallery icon in the bottom-left to choose an existing image.

steps.heading: Add the Photo sticker
steps.body: Tap the stickers icon at the top, then select the Photo sticker to add another picture on top of your first image.

steps.heading: Resize and arrange your photos
steps.body: Move, resize by pinching, and tap each photo to adjust its shape or layout, repeating the Photo sticker step to layer in more images.

steps.heading: Finish and post
steps.body: Add text, music, GIFs, or other elements as desired, then tap Your Story to post the finished collage.

faq.question: Do I need a third-party app to make a photo collage on Instagram stories?
faq.answer: No, you can layer multiple pictures using the built-in Photo sticker feature without any extra apps.

faq.question: How many photos can I add to one story?
faq.answer: You can layer several photos by repeating the Photo sticker step, though it's best to keep the layout clean and readable.

faq.question: Can I resize the photos after adding them?
faq.answer: Yes, you can pinch to resize each photo and move it around before finalizing your story.

faq.question: Can I still add text or music to a multi-photo story?
faq.answer: Yes, you can add text, music, GIFs, or other stickers on top of your layered photos before posting.
